events.reply:
A new reporting dashboard should read from BigQuery, your analytics warehouse.

Reasons:
- It's built for analytical query patterns (large scans, aggregations), so dashboards will perform better.
- It keeps heavy reporting load off your production PostgreSQL database.
- The nightly ETL at 02:00 UTC already lands data there, so it's the intended reporting source. Just be aware dashboard figures will be as fresh as the last ETL run.

Query production PostgreSQL directly only if you need real-time, up-to-the-minute data that can't tolerate the ETL lag.
